why: Opar (DC1 e104a) as Monica's Himarra form (DC2 monster 52, act script f216a). f216a binds dcol00/dcol01/bcol00 by name, so hit frames take the two-digit rename. Aliases cover every KEY name in the native e216a.cfg plus the motion names actionchara.cpp's built-in move requests; slots are Opar's DC1 info.cfg slots (dc1_NN).
scale_why: The DC1-to-DC2 world scale (1.5585) makes Opar fill the player camera and pushes it into walls in a corridor; 0.6 fits Himarra's slot and camera (runs monica-walk vs monica-walk-s060, 2026-10-14).
